awards.title: St. Louis Magazine Excellence in Nursing-Recipent of Women's Health Award
World Congress Leadership Summit on Medicaid Managed Care Featured Speaker
awards.summary: Kristine Ziegler spoke at the Seventh Annual World Congress Leadership Summit on Medicaid Managed Care to hundreds of health care professionals from numerous regions who gathered to discuss health care programs, care coordination and industry challenges and trends. Ziegler will deliver an informative and engaging presentation titled, “Creating High Touch Points with Medicaid Members.” The presentation includes an overview of NurseWise’s approach of creating high touch points with members to improve adherence, the elements needed to develop the right programs to educate members and increase adherence rates, and examples of adherence efforts that have shown a positive return on investment for the member, provider and plan. “Krissy’s health care experience is far reaching,” said Kim Tuck, RN, President and CEO of NurseWise. “She is the perfect expert to provide conference attendees with proven best practices and innovative approaches to helping plans achieve their goals and improve member health.”

awards.title: 2013 March of Dimes Nurse of the Year Finalist
awards.summary: Kristine Ziegler was nominated for the 2013 March of Dimes Nurse of the Year award in the category of Nursing Administration. Nurse of the Year nominees represent excellence in approximately 20 award categories and honors nurses who exemplify an extraordinary level of patient care, compassion and customer service.

awards.title: Dorland Health People Awards - Clinical Nurse Leadership
awards.summary: During the her recognition, it was stated that Ziegler was chosen based on her leadership, creativity, and innovation, as well as being a member of the care coordination team of NurseWise. “Krissy is much deserving of this recognition for her leadership and efforts in helping to make health care safer, better and more quality-driven for all those we serve,” said Kimberly D. Tuck, RN, Chief Executive Officer of NurseWise. “The Dorland Health People Awards are intended to recognize those healthcare professionals who are changing the culture of healthcare to be patient and family focused and provide access to consumers of healthcare across the care continuum,” says Anne Llewellyn, Editor in Chief with Dorland Health. “The People Awards recognize the front line professionals who inspire, motivate and empower their colleagues and who are making a real difference improving the lives of their patients as they transition through the care continuum.”

Enrich person.summary: Well-diversified health care executive with nearly two decades of experience ranging from hospital, managed care industry and government lines of business. Experience with various products in multiple states. Serving in the managed care organization industry for the past sixteen years in a broad range of disciplines including medical management, quality, operations, finance, contracting, and provider relations. Successes include acquisition of business line in order to expand external clientele, incremental growth, substantial increase in operational efficiencies, optimal staffing performance level, and service metrics. Specializing in oversight of revenue growth and financials, customer delight, expansion of service and product offerings, budgetary responsibility including G&A management and positive contribution, technology advancements, competitive intelligence and streamlining business units and processes.
